### fixupLoopInstrs() {#a40ca1821d0be81473a93800b4f59028f}

<div class="doxyMemberItem">
<div class="doxyMemberProto">
<table class="doxyMemberLabels">
<tr class="doxyMemberLabels">

<table class="doxyMemberName">

<td class="doxyMemberName">bool HexagonFixupHwLoops::fixupLoopInstrs (<a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/machinefunction">MachineFunction</a> &amp; MF)</td>
</tr>
</table>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>Check the offset between each loop instruction and the loop basic block to determine if we can use the LOOP instruction or if we need to set the LC/SA registers explicitly.</p>


<p>For <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/namespaces/llvm/hexagon">Hexagon</a>, if the loop label is to far from the loop instruction then we need to set the LC0 and SA0 registers explicitly instead of using LOOP(start,count).</p>


<p>This function checks the distance, and generates register assignments if needed.</p>


<p>This function makes two passes over the basic blocks. The first pass computes the offset of the basic block from the start. The second pass checks all the loop instructions.</p>


<p>Definition at line 65 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/lib/lib/target/lib/target/hexagon/hexagonfixuphwloops-cpp">HexagonFixupHwLoops.cpp</a>.</p>

</div>
</div>
